Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.relations

Class HasManyThrough<R extends Model>

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.relations.Relation<R,HasManyThrough<R>>
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.relations.HasOneOrManyThrough<R,HasManyThrough<R>>
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.relations.HasManyThrough<R>
Type Parameters:
R - the related model class
public final class HasManyThrough<R extends Model> extends HasOneOrManyThrough<R,HasManyThrough<R>>
A has-many-through relation: the far parent has many related rows through an intermediate model, such as a country with many posts through its users. Laravel's HasManyThrough.

The lazy query joins the through table and filters on its first key: select posts.*, users.country_id as laravel_through_key from posts inner join users on users.id = posts.user_id where users.country_id = ?. A related row reachable through two through rows is returned twice. Single use, not safe to share across threads (see HasOneOrManyThrough).

      public HasManyThrough(EloquentBuilder<R> query, Model farParent, Model throughParent, String firstKey, String secondKey, String localKey, String secondLocalKey)
      Builds the relation over the related query and the six keys.
      Parameters:
      query - the related model's query, never null
      farParent - the model the relation is read from, never null
      throughParent - an instance of the through model, never null
      firstKey - the through table's column that holds the far parent's key, never null
      secondKey - the related table's column that holds the through key, never null
      localKey - the far parent's column the first key points at, never null
      secondLocalKey - the through table's column the second key points at, never null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null

    • one

      public HasOneThrough<R> one()
      Returns a one-result relation over the same path and far parent: Laravel's one(), the way to latestOfMany() and its kin. It is built on this relation's constrained query, so the through join, the key condition and every clause recorded here are kept, each once. Trashed through parents stay kept when HasOneOrManyThrough.withTrashedParents() was called. The two relations share that query, as in Laravel: a join that latestOfMany() adds on the returned relation is also seen when this relation is read afterwards.
      Returns:
      a new relation, never null

      public final R createOrFirst(Map<String,?> attributes)
      Creates a related model from the attributes, or returns the existing match when a unique index refuses the insert. Inside a transaction the insert runs in a savepoint, so the refusal does not abort the transaction. The created row is not linked to the far parent.
      Parameters:
      attributes - the columns to match, never null
      Returns:
      the model, never null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if attributes is null
      UniqueConstraintViolationException - if the insert is refused and no match is found

    • createOrFirst

      public final R createOrFirst(Map<String,?> attributes, Map<String,?> values)
      Creates a related model from the attributes and the values, or returns the existing match when a unique index refuses the insert. Inside a transaction the insert runs in a savepoint, so the refusal does not abort the transaction. The match is read through the relation. The created row is not linked to the far parent.
      Parameters:
      attributes - the columns to match, never null
      values - more attributes for the new model, never null
      Returns:
      the model, never null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      MassAssignmentException - if the related model's guards refuse an attribute
      UniqueConstraintViolationException - if the insert is refused and no match is found through the relation

      public final R findSole(Object id)
      Finds the only related model with the given key, reading at most two rows, so a key that joins to several through rows is refused.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the model, never null
      Throws:
      ModelNotFoundException - if the far parent has no such related model
      MultipleRecordsFoundException - if the key matches more than one row
      IllegalArgumentException - if id is a Collection

      public final HasManyThrough<R> orWhere(String column, Object value)
      Adds or column = value to the lazy query.
      Parameters:

      value - the value
